summary: Staff give {board} a study of long-term renewals and explain why the sample cannot count every long-term tenant.
realLife: After an April 2026 board request, staff analyzed lease histories using registration records. They cautioned against treating the number of matched units as a citywide count of long-term tenants.
gates: The case record identifies the board request, inclusion criteria and denominator.
inGame: needs: board request, inclusion criteria and denominator.

turns.what: Staff report proportions within the matched group.
